Build prompt

Rebuild this animation 1:1: CRED's invite screen - a black ₹200 card rotates in 3D over the white screen, gets flicked away, and is replaced by a fan of stacked cards before settling into the earn module with toggle chips and an "Earn ₹200" button.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
White screen with a faint dotted grid that fades out: "now invite CRED members and earn more" fixed at the bottom. Center stage: a glossy black reward card ("₹200", EARN, CRED branding) rendered as a 3D object. Later states: a fanned stack of multiple card designs, and a final module with two toggle chips and a dark "Earn ₹200" pill.

## Motion spec
Pattern: physics card flick, ~3s sequence.
- Entrance: the card drops in and rotates to rest (rotateY 25deg -> -8deg, spring ~280/18, 600ms) with a soft floor shadow tracking it.
- Idle: the card floats (rotateZ +-3deg, translateY +-5px, 2.4s sine).
- Flick: a swipe flings the card off-screen (velocity-based, rotation following the flick direction, 400ms) and the next card flies in from the opposite side (spring ~300/20).
- Fan: cards stack into a fanned pile (each offset -8deg, staggered 70ms springs), then clear to reveal the module.
- Module: toggle chips slide up (200ms, 60ms stagger), then the "Earn ₹200" pill scales in (0.9 -> 1, spring ~380/20).

## Calibration
- Flicks are physics-driven: fast swipe throws far, slow swipe settles back to center.
- The bottom caption never moves; only the card stage animates.

## Reduced motion
Cards crossfade between states (250ms); module fades in.

## Don't miss
- The card has real 3D depth - edge thickness and gloss highlight shift as it rotates.
- The fan shows distinct card backs/designs, not copies of one card.
